hook: DeepSeek's kernels now hit 98.5% of chip peak.

beats.say: DeepSeek pushed updates across all four of its core infrastructure repos, and most of the work targets Huawei's Ascend nine fifty chips.
FlashMLA gained a fused attention kernel for Ascend, while DeepSelect added a faster top K operation and DeepGEMM Ascend got a new release.
The optimized sparse prefill kernels now reach up to four hundred twenty five teraflops on Ascend, about ninety eight point five percent of the hardware peak.
